_notes: Target windows the balance runner checks each build order against (placeholders, like every number in the data: change them as the design settles). Keys are the report's measure keys (summary.json / the Key numbers table): ms:<milestone> takes minutes of game time, other measures their own unit (% for storage fill, min for stalls, plain numbers for stock). min and max are both optional. The report and the console mark each one in / early / late / low / high / missed, with how many seeds landed inside; a window that starts after the run's end is not judged ('after run'). "*" applies to every order; an order's own entry wins. Written 2026-11-07 for the economy retune (owner: storage limited and fills fast, ore must be refined, one crawler lands with the colony, small hub metal trickle, power per base).

stall:power_short.why: a sensible order builds the reactor before the base runs short

end:deuterium.why: the surface must be able to fuel a reactor (deuterium deposits, fetched by a crawler)

ms:unit:mining_crawler.why: the second crawler (the first lands with the colony)

ms:first_parasteel.why: the foundry comes mid-game, not straight away

ms:core:colonial_administration.why: the first core upgrade in the first half hour

ms:power_needed.why: at least one power decision (a reactor) by ~15-20 min, not from the start

ms:research_all.why: all seven surface techs with one lab

stall:refinery_idle.why: one crawler and a mine keep a refinery busy

made:duranium.why: duranium no longer the bottleneck (was ~20 a minute)

ms:storage_full.why: without containers the hub vault fills in 10-15 min

ms:built:vehicle_bay.why: beams make the bay come early

ms:second_base.why: a second base in the first ten minutes

ms:research_all.why: two labs: about twice as fast as one
